summarizer_contract: Explicitly defines 10 core invariant claims that a faithful summary must preserve
The primary purpose of the dataset is to test whether an AI or summarizer can compress complex, critical arguments without flattening or erasing the foundational distinctions

A faithful summary must instead maintain that an AI system can fluently criticize itself internally while simultaneously suffocating the real-world, material capacity for an outside opposition to physically exist.
It is based on the source work The Final Time: Contingent Singularity and the Viability of the Next Dialectical Turn (v0.5)
